about: The window corpus the reference model was checked against (docs/resolution-model.md §12). "fixture" is null for zig-hocon conformance rows (z<issue>-<group>-<row>; vendored by #132), their key-renamed variants (fo-*), env-set cases and duplicates of existing fixtures. Errors are shown as ERR (compared by class only). verdict: agree | e23-order | e23-view-reentry | e23-memo | interim-128 | lb-artefact.
